params.description: Termite is expecting a number defining the extrusion multiplication factor applied when crossing a printed path. For each intersection (including self-intersections) of printing paths within the same XY plane, the extrusion of a segment with a length equal to the nozzle diameter is reduced for all subsequent paths crossing that intersection, in order to prevent material buildup. Intersections occurring at start points, end points, or seam points of subsequent paths are excluded. Set the value to 1 to disable this feature (0.0-10.0)
params.name: Crossing Extrusion Factor

params.description: Termite is expecting a number defining the speed multiplication factor applied when crossing a printed path. For each intersection (including self-intersections) of printing paths within the same XY plane, the speed of a segment with a length equal to the nozzle diameter is multiplied for all subsequent paths crossing that intersection, in order to prevent material buildup. Intersections occurring at start points, end points, or seam points of subsequent paths are excluded. Set the value to 1 to disable this feature (0.0-10.0)
params.name: Crossing Speed Factor
